title: Baidoa Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan (HHAMP) - Baidoa District, Somalia
organization: Ministry of Health & Human Services – Federal Government of Somalia, International Medical Corps
landscapes: Arid, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Urban
description: The Baidoa District Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan is a district-level, multi-sectoral initiative that addresses extreme heat through coordinated action across communities, health systems and local institutions. It focuses on interventions spanning health, water, shelter, urban planning, disaster risk reduction, and community engagement, with specific attention paid to Internally Displaced Populations (IDPs), and other vulnerable groups. The plan establishes a Heat-Health Taskforce and includes simulation drills, monitoring and evaluation mechanisms, and annual reviews, with the explicit aim of serving as a scalable model for other heat-affected areas in Somalia.
